verdict.line: You lose every trade where Teemo pokes you down with ranged Toxic Shot autos while Blinding Dart is up, and you win the instant you catch him with Q-W-E in the window right after that Dart goes on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Jax's whole kit — Empower (W), the auto-attack dodge in Counter Strike (E), and the stacking attack speed of Relentless Assault (R) — all require him to land and chain basic attacks, and Teemo's Blinding Dart exists specifically to turn that off. Blinding Dart is only 8 seconds on cooldown, so this isn't a lane Jax loses on raw stats (it's listed EVEN, with solo-kill edge to Jax) — it's a lane he wins by refusing to engage until the Dart clock is dead.

theirWindow.when: the moment he lands Blinding Dart on you
theirWindow.what: You're blind — your autos miss, so W's empowered strike and R's attack-speed stacks do nothing. Back off to minions, don't swing, and let the blind timer run out instead of fighting through it.

yourWindow.when: Blinding Dart just went on cooldown (8s)
yourWindow.what: This is the only time to commit. Leap Strike (Q) onto him, pop Empower (W) on the landing hit, and follow with Counter Strike (E) — the stun lands clean because he has no blind to answer it with.

start.why: 46% win rate over 859 games and the clear majority pick (57%) — the sustain and regen offset the constant Toxic Shot poison tick while you're forced to walk up through his range.

boots.why: 76.4% pick rate, 48.1% win rate. Tenacity shortens the Blinding Dart blind and any Noxious Trap slow, and the magic resist blunts the Toxic Shot DoT he's poking you with all lane.

core.why: the highest-picked core path (11.3%, 48.9% WR) — the burst and move speed are what let you actually catch him once Blinding Dart is down.

runes.keystoneWhy: 45.8% win rate, and it's the better fit here — every auto you land on him or a minion heals you back through the Toxic Shot DoT that's chipping you down between your all-in windows.

summoners.why: 64.4% pick rate and the top win rate (46.1%). Since the data flags Jax with the solo-kill advantage in this matchup, Ignite converts the post-Dart all-in into an actual kill instead of a trade; Flash guarantees you close the gap the instant his Blind expires.

playing.title: Don't swing through a blind
playing.detail: Counter Strike (E) only dodges basic attacks — it does nothing against Blinding Dart itself. If you're blinded, disengage to minions and wait it out rather than trying to trade.

playing.title: Fight the cooldown, not the champion
playing.detail: Track the 8-second Blinding Dart timer all lane. Every all-in should start the moment it's confirmed down, not when you feel ready.

playing.title: Leap onto him, not past him
playing.detail: Leap Strike (Q) has 700 range at rank 1 with a 17s cooldown — use it to close distance only once Dart is gone, since a wasted Q leaves you stranded in his auto-attack range for 17 seconds.

playing.title: Hold minions as a shield
playing.detail: Walk the wave into him so his Toxic Shot autos hit minions too, not just you, while you wait out the Dart cooldown.

playing.title: Don't facecheck brush blind
playing.detail: Camouflage lets him go invisible if he stands still — if he vanishes near a bush, assume Element of Surprise attack speed on his next reveal and don't walk in without a ward.

playing.title: Chain attacks once the stun lands
playing.detail: Relentless Assault (R) has no cooldown but needs consecutive hits to ramp attack speed and trigger its bonus every third strike — don't disengage early or you reset the stacks you just built.

playing.title: Respect Noxious Traps in the river
playing.detail: Mushrooms are near-instant to place (1s cooldown) and slow plus damage over time — clear obvious ones in river/jungle entrances before pathing into a fight blind.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1); the timing windows, ability interactions, and lane-execution advice are my own tactical read, not scraped data.
